title: Electricity in rural India
hook: Last month, the Smart Power India and the Initiative for Sustainable Energy Policy published Rural Electricity Demand in India, a new survey dataset that “covers 10,000 households and 2,000 rural enterprises across 200 villages in Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, Odisha, and Rajasthan.” Respondents were asked, among other things, how many hours per day they get electricity, whether they have solar panels, and the price they pay for kerosene.
